_readme: WP7 known failures: engine-checkable worked examples that do not pass against the generated snapshots, with the triage category and the routed fix.

Both harnesses (api/test/card_worked_examples.test.js, packages/pandapay_domain/test/card_worked_examples_test.dart) assert that each listed example STILL fails in the listed engines, so a fix shows up as a failing test until its entry is removed. No example is skipped silently.
Keys are <source_slug>#<example id>. category: example_wrong | research_data | directory_data | loader_bug | engine_bug.

axis-bank-magnus#006.summary: 35 pts/Rs200 above Rs1.5 lakh a month needs base_150k_spend to carry post_cap_behavior custom_rate (35 per Rs200). The loader only emits base_rate/zero, so the accelerated band earns the base 12.

axis-bank-magnus#007.summary: Same as #006: spend after the Rs1.5 lakh line should earn 35 per Rs200 (custom post-cap rate).

flipkart-axis-bank-credit-card#006.summary: The preferred-merchant list is not published (research note), so preferred_merchants_cashback_4 stays info (H2). Cite an issuer list naming Swiggy (then override merchant Swiggy, except Instamart/Genie) or mark the example engine_checkable false.

swiggy-hdfc-bank-credit-card#004.summary: T&C 2.3: 5% online applies only to select merchants mapped under the Table 1.2 MCCs; the merchant list is not published, so an MCC-only rule would widen (H2) and online_5pct stays info. Needs the merchant list, or engine_checkable false.

tata-neu-infinity-hdfc-bank#004.summary: Not an engine defect against the contract: the issuer rounds the base 1.5% and the additional 3.5% separately (316.5 -> 317 plus 738.5 -> 739 = 1,056); C3.5/D7 round the rule's whole accrual once (1,055). Needs a component-wise rounding mode if the 1-point gap matters. The partner-brand rule itself now loads (group token + EMI/UPI carve-outs).
